set.body: Real ds000001 native FirstLevelReview fails all4 subjects beta and FIR before plan construction: FirstLevelTables.bind rejects n/a in unused cash_demean/control_pumps_demean/explode_demean columns. Requested model is categorical trial_type with onset/duration and six motion confounds; optional modulation fields are not model inputs. Correct in native dataset/workflow/model boundary via explicit event-column selection or properly modeled missingness. Preserve full source table identity/provenance; never impute n/a as zero or categorical level and never silently drop missing requested regressors. Retain validation of required event timing and conflicting run identity. Expose an ordinary API that application model selection can use; no application-local event-table rewriter or formula parser. Test missing unselected vs selected columns, beta/FIR native planning, full source receipts, JVM/JS. Consumer plsneuro bd-01M1VJB639V2PT8SWZAVCNG06D, /private/tmp/plsneuro-ds000001-first-level-review-1.json. DatasetEvents currently requires equal row fields and has no Missing DatasetValue, so deleting arbitrary absent keys is insufficient.
set.title: Bind model-selected event fields without rejecting unused nullable columns
